before.question:
Determine the unknown concentration by reading the calibration graph at its indicated signal0.70.

Signal dimensionless versus concentration mol/dm3. Straight model S=20c+0.1 over0.01 to0.05; marked measured standards. Horizontal guide at signal0.70 crosses at concentration0.03. Read the unknown from the graph.
before.answer: The horizontal signal0.70 guide meets the fitted line at concentration about0.030 mol dm−3. Read the corresponding x-coordinate; this is interpolation within the measured range.
